# scripting

`filesystem::component`, `gametypes::component`, and `gsc::component` integrate prioritized file overrides, gametype UI discovery, and custom GSC loading with fixed-layout engine hooks.

## Contents

- [filesystem.cpp](./filesystem.cpp) — `filesystem::component` manages search paths, file resolution, `exec_stub()`, and install-path hooks.
- [filesystem.hpp](./filesystem.hpp) — `read_file()`, `find_file()`, `exists()`, and search-path registration declarations.
- [gametypes.cpp](./gametypes.cpp) — `gametypes::component` resolves rawfile overrides, rebuilds UI gametype caches, and writes debug dumps.
- [gametypes.hpp](./gametypes.hpp) — `gametypes::refresh_ui_gametype_list()`, `force_refresh_ui_gametype_list()`, and `dump_debug_state()` declarations.
- [gsc.cpp](./gsc.cpp) — `gsc::component` loads custom GSC scripts, dispatches registered functions and methods, redirects replacements, and reports compile errors.
- [gsc.hpp](./gsc.hpp) — `gsc::add_function()` and `gsc::add_method()` declarations.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`filesystem::register_path()` populates prioritized lookup state, while `filesystem::read_file()` and `filesystem::get_search_paths()` feed `gametypes` and `gsc` override discovery.

`gametypes::db_find_xasset_header_internal_stub()` applies patch-zone, disk, and original database lookup; `rebuild_ui_gametype_cache()` merges `_gametypes.txt`, patch assets, and disk files into both UI arrays.

`gsc::load_gametype_script_stub()` scans search paths, `gsc::load_script()` records `main_handles` and `init_handles`, and `g_load_structs_stub()` plus `save_reigstered_weapons_stub()` execute those handles during engine startup.

## Patterns

`REGISTER_COMPONENT(filesystem::component)`, `REGISTER_COMPONENT(gametypes::component)`, and `REGISTER_COMPONENT(gsc::component)` activate component lifecycle integration.

`loaded_gametype_rawfiles`, `loaded_scaleform_rawfiles`, and `loaded_scripts` memoize allocated `game::RawFile` objects for repeated asset lookup.

`gsc::add_function()` and `gsc::add_method()` lowercase names before storing dispatch entries in `scr_functions` and `scr_methods`.

## Behavioral Contracts

`normalize_exec_path()` appends `.cfg` when no extension follows the final `/` or `\`.

`exec_stub()` delegates `config_mp.cfg` and `gfxConfig.cfg` case-insensitively and logs `execing %s from %s\n`.

`GAMETYPES_LIST` equals `"maps/mp/gametypes/_gametypes.txt"` and `GAMETYPE_PREFIX` equals `"maps/mp/gametypes/"`.

`UI_GAMETYPE_MAX` equals `0x20`, `GAMETYPE_ENTRY_SIZE` equals `0x2C`, and `append_unique_gametype_id()` lowercases accepted IDs while hiding only `"menu"`.

`parse_gametype_display_name()` removes `//` comments and one surrounding quote pair; `dump_parsed_ui_gametypes()` emits `"{} \"{}\"\r\n"`.

`append_bytes()` emits `"  {} @ {:08X}: "` followed by `"{:02X} "` or `"?? "` and terminates rows with `"\r\n"`.

`compile_error_stub()` and `compile_error_2_stub()` print `******* script compile error *******` and terminate with `"script compile error\n%s\n%s\n(see console for details)\n"`.

`replacefunc` requires exactly two parameters; `get_code_pos_for_param()` reports `"get_code_pos_for_param: Index is out of range!\n"` and `"get_code_pos_for_param: Invalid type! (Expects a function as parameter)\n"`.

## Fixed Integration Points

`filesystem::component::post_load()` hooks `0x10272D80`, `0x103F5960`, `0x10274AA0`, and `0x103F589B`.

`gametypes::component::post_load()` patches `0x102DEA4A`, `0x102DE2F5`, and `0x102D4A12`, while `gametypes::component::pre_destroy()` clears override maps and `ui_gametype_list_refreshed`.

`gsc::component::post_load()` hooks `0x101A8ED4`, `0x101AD1FA`, `0x101AD27A`, `0x1022DC10`, `0x1022DD40`, and `0x1022DC70`.

`vm_execute_stub()` and `add_engine_search_path()` use x86 inline assembly, making `0x116377F8`, `0x11738440`, and all hook offsets version-sensitive.

## Lifecycle

`filesystem::initialized` gates `register_path()` and `unregister_path()`, while `engine_paths_enabled` and `engine_paths_registered` control engine search-path registration.

`gametypes::ui_gametype_list_refreshed` becomes true after successful `rebuild_ui_gametype_cache()` and resets during `gametypes::component::pre_destroy()`.

`scheduler::on_shutdown` clears `main_handles`, `init_handles`, `replaced_functions`, and `loaded_scripts`; `scr_functions` and `scr_methods` remain registered.
